web.title: Thand Ka Parcel: Winter Pass the Parcel Kitty Party Game
web.description: Thand Ka Parcel is a winter pass the parcel game for kitty parties where every layer hides a sock or cap you must wear. Rules, setup, twists and tips.
web.intro: Thand Ka Parcel is a winter version of pass the parcel where every newspaper layer hides one woollen item, like a sock, monkey cap, muffler or gloves. When the music stops, the lady holding the parcel tears one layer and must wear whatever she finds until the game ends, and whoever opens the last layer wins the prize inside. The crazy twist: when the host shouts "Heater on!", every lady must take off one thing she is wearing and put it on the lady to her right. It needs only old newspapers, tape, a small prize and the winter clothes already in your cupboard, so it is perfect for the first cold kitty of the season.
materials: A small prize such as a chocolate bar or a toffee pack
Old newspapers and tape to make about 10 layers
About 10 clean winter items: socks, monkey caps, mufflers, gloves, a shawl, ear muffs
Music on a phone or speaker, and one person to play and stop it
steps: Wrap the prize in one layer of newspaper, then keep adding layers until there are about 10. Tuck one winter item inside every layer as you wrap.
Everyone sits in a circle. Play music and pass the parcel from hand to hand.
Stop the music suddenly. The lady holding the parcel has 10 seconds to tear open one layer.
Whatever falls out, she must wear right away and keep on until the game ends, even if it is a sock on her hand.
At any moment the host can shout "Heater on!" and every lady must take off one worn item and put it on the lady to her right within 10 seconds.
rules: If you take off a worn item on your own, you sit out one round.
If you cannot open a layer in 10 seconds, the parcel moves on and you lose your turn.
If you are slow on "Heater on!", you must wear one extra item.
The lady who opens the last layer wins the prize and is crowned Sardi Queen.
variations: Every lady who gets an item must sing one line of a winter or Bollywood barish song.
Hide the husband's old muffler in one layer for big laughs.
End with a group photo in all the mismatched winter wear, posing like a Shimla trip.
tips: Use only clean, washed items and skip anything with sharp pins or buckles.
Tape each layer lightly so it tears open in 10 seconds.
Keep the parcel moving fast and stop the music at unexpected moments.

faq.q: How many players do you need for Thand Ka Parcel?
faq.a: It works for 8 to 20 ladies sitting in one circle. With more than 15, make 12 to 15 layers so more people get an item.

faq.q: What do you need to play Thand Ka Parcel?
faq.a: Old newspapers, tape, a small prize and about 10 clean winter items like socks, caps, mufflers and gloves, plus music.

faq.q: How is it different from normal pass the parcel?
faq.a: Every layer hides something you must wear, and the "Heater on!" call makes everyone pass worn items to the right, so the whole room ends up in funny mismatched winter wear.

faq.q: Is Thand Ka Parcel good for a winter or pajama theme kitty?
faq.a: Yes. It fits a winter, cozy pajama or Christmas theme kitty and makes a great first game because it warms up the room quickly.

faq.q: How long does the game take?
faq.a: About 15 minutes for a 10 layer parcel. Add or remove layers to make it longer or shorter.
